data.name: Khadija
data.gender_notes: Khadija is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root خ-د-ج (kh-d-j), 'to come early'. Khadīja means 'one born prematurely' or 'early child'. Its root is خ-د-ج (kh-d-j). Borne by Khadīja bint Khuwaylid, the first wife of the Prophet ﷺ. Khadija is a Arabic name meaning “Born prematurely; early child”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Khadija expresses “Born prematurely; early child”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root خ-د-ج (kh-d-j), 'to come early'. Khadīja means 'one born prematurely' or 'early child'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khadija total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
